title: Sell outcomes, eliminate creator side quests, keep the execution substrate replaceable

source.ref: Strategy thesis — Sell outcomes, eliminate creator side quests, keep execution substrate replaceable

summary: Sell creator outcomes, not tools or temporary middle layers. No creator side quests; one accountable agent, swarms and model routing stay internal. Service → managed outcome → autonomy ladder. Model/harness/sandbox substrate is replaceable. Free tiers are bounded subsidies — no lifetime deals or irreversible marginal-cost obligations. Productize observed delegation behavior.
